name: code-block
title: CodeBlock
description: Figure with a scrollable, focusable code area, an optional caption and source, a copy button and marked bad lines; framed, plain or bare, or the <pre> alone (frame="none").

keyboard: Moves focus to the code area so it can be scrolled
aria: The scrollable <pre> is focusable and named by the caption (role="region" + aria-label)
With focusable="overflow" the <pre> is focusable and named only while its content actually scrolls (RGAA 7.3); otherwise it is plain text (default: always focusable)
With focusable="never" the <pre> is never focusable nor named: use it only when the code cannot scroll or an ancestor already gives keyboard access (WCAG 2.1.1)

With frame="none" (Angular: <pre mkCodeBlock>) only the <pre> is rendered: no <figure>, header or copy button. focusable="always" → tabindex="0" + role="region" + aria-label from label (else caption, language, "Code"); "overflow" → the same only while it scrolls; "never" → a plain <pre>
With a source, the caption is shown as an uppercase title (text-transform only, the accessible text is unchanged) and the source is plain text after it
A bad line shows a visible ✕ marker and a visible note; the note is also read by assistive technology
The copy button announces "Copied" or "Copy failed" through a polite live region (copy-button)
a11y.notes: Pass lines for per-line markers, or code for plain text. Long lines scroll inside the region (no loss of content at 320px). variant="bare" drops the frame, header and padding for a <pre> inside a card; headerTone="raised" puts the header on --raised. frame="none" renders only <pre class="code-pre"> with the data-* hooks; with variant="bare" it has no border, radius or padding, so the page keeps its own padding class.
